sum: BitFuFu Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides digital asset mining solutions in North America, Asia, Africa, Oceania, Europe, and internationally. The company offers cloud-mining and miner hosting services to institutional customers and individual digital asset enthusiasts. It also provides Bitcoin self-mining, mining machine hosting, and other services. In addition, the company leases and sells mining equipment. BitFuFu Inc. is headquartered in Singapore.
ceo: Mr. Leo  Lu (Chairman of the Board & CEO)
